note: Add the unified PYTHIA plugin (cloud + CLI + Desktop, one install) via the Devin UI dialog 'Add plugin from repository'. Devin reads the plugin from the repository each time it runs, so changes there take effect without re-adding it.

Repository.note: Don't include plaintext secrets. Use plugin secret references instead.

Subdirectory.note: The plugin's root inside the repository: the folder containing .devin-plugin/plugin.json. Never enter this file's path (plugins/ORG_REQUIRED_MANIFEST.json) here — this file is a handoff doc, not a plugin root.
